claim: For the two-site, zero-hopping, one-mode Holstein pure-dephasing instance of the stochastic-phase bath reduction in arXiv:2609.28318v1, with equal site energies, initial electronic state \((|1\rangle+|2\rangle)/\sqrt2\), oscillator frequency \(\omega>0\), coupling \(g\neq0\), inverse temperature \(\beta>0\), and \(a=g^2(1-\cos(\omega t))\), the exact independent-bath coherence is \(L_\infty=e^{-2a\coth(\beta\omega/2)}\), while the phase-averaged \(R\)-bath coherence is exactly \(L_R=L_\infty I_0(2a\,\operatorname{csch}(\beta\omega/2)/R)^R\). Hence the trace-norm reduced-state error equals \(L_R-L_\infty>0\) whenever \(t\notin 2\pi\mathbb Z/\omega\), and \[\lim_{R\to\infty}R\,\|\rho_s^{(R)}(t)-\rho_s(t)\|_{\mathrm{tr}}=e^{-2a\coth(\beta\omega/2)}a^2\operatorname{csch}^2(\beta\omega/2)>0.\] Therefore the source paper's general fixed-time \(O(R^{-1})\) convergence rate is asymptotically sharp even for two sites and a single thermal mode; in this witness the finite-\(R\) method under-dephases, while the zero-temperature boundary is exact for every \(R\).

correctness.rationale: The displaced-oscillator propagator and thermal Weyl characteristic function give both coherence factors exactly. The shared-bath phase integral is the standard integral representation of \(I_0\) with argument \(2a\,\operatorname{csch}(\beta\omega/2)/R\). The resulting \(2\times2\) density-matrix difference has trace norm exactly equal to the coherence difference, and the \(I_0\) series yields a strictly positive \(R^{-1}\) coefficient at finite temperature away from revival times.
risks: The proof is scoped to the zero-hopping one-mode witness and does not transfer the closed form to general transport models.

value.rationale: The source introduces a new scalable simulation method whose rigorous guarantee is \(O(R^{-1})\). Establishing a minimal explicit witness with an exact finite-\(R\) error and a positive asymptotic coefficient shows that the rate exponent is genuinely optimal, while the zero-temperature boundary explains when this obstruction disappears. This is a structural calibration of the theorem, not a routine parameter tweak.
risks: The witness does not prove practical worst-case error for transport observables with nonzero hopping.
